<documents>
<document id="account-under-review">
AccountˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆSometimesˆweˆneedˆtoˆreviewˆanˆaccount,ˆforˆexampleˆtoˆconfirmˆidentityˆdetails,ˆcheckˆunusualˆactivity,ˆorˆmeetˆlegalˆrequirements.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆcanˆdoˆduringˆaˆreviewˆYouˆcanˆstillˆreceiveˆdeposits.ˆDependingˆonˆtheˆreview,ˆyouˆmayˆnotˆbeˆableˆtoˆsendˆmoney,ˆwithdrawˆcash,ˆuseˆyourˆcardˆorˆorderˆaˆnewˆcard.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyou'llˆseeˆAˆbannerˆinˆtheˆappˆtellsˆyouˆtheˆaccountˆisˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestricted,ˆandˆwhatˆweˆneedˆfromˆyou,ˆifˆanything.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆItˆdependsˆonˆtheˆreason.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆdocuments,ˆsendingˆthemˆquicklyˆisˆtheˆbestˆwayˆtoˆspeedˆthingsˆup.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆhelp?ˆSupportˆcan'tˆliftˆaˆreviewˆorˆrestriction,ˆandˆoftenˆcan'tˆshareˆtheˆreason.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆmessageˆtoˆtheˆVerificationˆteam,ˆwhoˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆrestrictionsˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆbecauseˆofˆaˆnegativeˆbalance,ˆaddingˆmoneyˆliftsˆtheˆrestrictionˆonceˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="support-what-we-can-do">
WhatˆourˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆsortˆoutˆmostˆthingsˆduringˆyourˆchat.ˆSomeˆrequestsˆgoˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteam,ˆandˆaˆfewˆthingsˆweˆcan'tˆdoˆatˆall.ˆ##ˆSupportˆcanˆ-ˆFreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆyourˆcardˆ-ˆReportˆaˆcardˆlostˆorˆstolenˆandˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆ-ˆOpenˆaˆdisputeˆthat'sˆinsideˆitsˆwindow,ˆhasˆposted,ˆandˆtotalsˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆ-ˆRefundˆaˆfeeˆunderˆourˆrefundˆpolicyˆ-ˆChangeˆyourˆplanˆ-ˆCloseˆyourˆaccountˆifˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆzeroˆandˆnothingˆisˆpendingˆorˆdisputedˆ-ˆExplainˆfees,ˆlimitsˆandˆpoliciesˆ##ˆSupportˆpassesˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteamˆ-ˆ**Fraud:**ˆsuspectedˆaccountˆtakeover,ˆremovingˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆscamˆpaymentsˆ-ˆ**Disputes:**ˆdisputesˆaboveˆtheˆsupportˆlimitˆ-ˆ**Verification:**ˆidentityˆchecks,ˆlegalˆnameˆorˆdate-of-birthˆchanges,ˆaccountsˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆ-ˆ**AccountˆServices:**ˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆaˆdeceasedˆaccountˆholder,ˆfinancialˆabuseˆ-ˆ**Complaints:**ˆformalˆcomplaintsˆSpecialistˆteamsˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆSupportˆcan'tˆ-ˆActˆfor,ˆorˆshareˆdetailsˆwith,ˆanyoneˆotherˆthanˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆ-ˆGiveˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadviceˆ-ˆRaiseˆlimitsˆ-ˆRefundˆfeesˆoutsideˆtheˆrefundˆpolicy,ˆorˆopenˆdisputesˆafterˆtheirˆwindowˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="card-replacement-premium">
CardˆreplacementˆfeesˆonˆPremiumˆThisˆisˆwhatˆaˆreplacementˆcardˆcostsˆonˆtheˆPremiumˆplan,ˆwhetherˆit'sˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged.ˆ|ˆ|ˆCostˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆReplacementˆcardˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆStandardˆshippingˆ(7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆ(2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆOnˆPremiumˆbothˆtheˆcardˆandˆexpeditedˆshippingˆareˆfree.ˆYourˆreplacementˆisˆaˆmetalˆcard.ˆ##ˆWhenˆweˆdon'tˆchargeˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆwhenˆaˆcardˆisˆlostˆinˆtheˆmail,ˆwhenˆweˆreplaceˆaˆcardˆbecauseˆofˆaˆproblemˆonˆourˆside,ˆorˆforˆyourˆautomaticˆrenewalˆcard.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆorderˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆthenˆReplaceˆcard.ˆPickˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged,ˆandˆchooseˆaˆshippingˆspeed.ˆFeesˆareˆchargedˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆyouˆplaceˆtheˆorder.ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆforˆyouˆinˆtheˆappˆchat.ˆTheˆsameˆfeesˆapplyˆeitherˆway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
